programme.title: Trouble
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: Ticks
programme.desc: Brothers Kyle and Odessa James have been found guilty of the murder of their parents and are sentenced to death. Shortly before their execution, the two shockingly escape from prison. The brothers hide out at a seemingly unsuspecting family home. When they find the Ryan family strangely easy to manipulate, they get comfortable, having no idea that this family harbors violent secrets of their own.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: The Local Knowledge crew heads to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California to participate in the 2024 War Heroes On Water tournament. This event offers a unique opportunity for the sport fishing community to create meaningful connections with our nation's heroes while raising awareness of the challenges they sometimes face when transitioning back to civilian life. With a little bit of luck and a lot of teamwork, Ali and Rush hope to put their veterans on a Bluefin tuna bite they won't forget!
